description.value:
Cost 3 Zeal

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Fortitude

Drain a target for a serious wall of temporary HP.

The target attempts a Fortitude save against your class DC. On a failure, it takes 9d6 negative damage and is drained 2 (also enfeebled 1 until the drained condition is fully removed, on a critical failure). You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt, lasting 1 minute, either way; on a success, it takes half damage, you gain half the temporary Hit Points, and it isn't drained.
